description: Gym information batch 2: official website and weekly opening hours (only when all 7 days are stated) for gyms in Seattle, Denver, Boston and San Diego, from each gym's own site, researched 2026-10-04 (fill-only); plus 7 retirements: Hardrock Nunawading (closed 19 Dec 2025, operator notice), Denver Bouldering Club x3 (closed), Solid Rock Gym (now Vertical Hold San Marcos), The Rock Health and Fitness (not a climbing gym), The Wall at Palisades (no evidence it exists); owner rule 2026-10-04: if unsure, retire.
